name: io.github.MNKIAgentOS/mnki-mcp
description: MCP proxy that checks every tools/call against Agent Trust policy, with evidence, before it runs.

packageArguments.name: --agent
packageArguments.description: Agent identity the tool calls run under (create one in the console or with `mnki identity create`).

packageArguments.name: --server
packageArguments.description: Name of the protected server, used in the ledger and the shadow log.

packageArguments.name: --mode
packageArguments.description: observe (default: log only), warn, require_approval or enforce.

packageArguments.name: --upstream
packageArguments.description: The real MCP server to launch, after `--`: e.g. `-- npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-github`.

packageArguments.name: --upstream-url
packageArguments.description: Alternative to --upstream: a Streamable HTTP MCP server URL; add `--upstream-header k=v` for its auth.

environmentVariables.name: MNKI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Agent Trust API key with the verify scope (console → Settings → API keys).

environmentVariables.name: MNKI_URL
environmentVariables.description: Console base URL; https://mnki.com unless self-hosted.
